overall: Atlanta is running notably below model guidance as of 11:35 ET, with the running max stalled at 78.8°F and a velocity of exactly +0.0°F/hr — indicating temperatures have plateaued mid-morning. There are still roughly 3-4 hours of potential afternoon heating remaining, but the current stall casts doubt on whether the atmosphere will recover enough to close the gap to model guidance.

max_temp_prediction: Given the stall at 78.8°F with zero velocity at 11:35 ET, some afternoon recovery is still plausible as surface heating ramps up toward the typical 3–4 PM peak, but the current underperformance relative to all models and the flat trend make reaching 84°F+ unlikely. Confidence is moderate-low; the best estimate is around 82.0°F, with meaningful downside risk toward 80–81°F if the stall persists.
